name: Yagai Gakushuu 2
source: There is a program described as “Male and Female Practical Education”, it all started with a single classroom and eventually spread to others. This summer break Arita Atsushi was enrolled in this program. He's afraid he won't talk to any of his classmates because he gets nervous talking to others, especially girls. He doesn't know anything about this camp other than it's being held on a remote island, and he's really hoping the experience changes him for the better.
translation: 有一项名为“男女实地教育”的课程，最初只在一个班级实行，后来逐渐扩展到其他班级。这个暑假，主人公有田笃参加了这项课程。他不擅长与人交谈，尤其害怕和女孩说话，因此担心自己无法与同学交流。他只知道这场合宿将在一座偏远小岛上举行，并真心希望这段经历能让自己变得更好。
